cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a quiet neon-lit self-service laundromat at night with round unlettered machine doors and a row of orange plastic seats — she taps a rhythm softly on a laundry basket while waiting for the spin cycle; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — tears a finished page out of a notebook; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — holds her keepsake at chest height; a modern harbour passenger-ferry bow under an overcast sky — she pauses during a ferry crossing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sweeps the stones off a go board with black and white stones into their bowls; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — holds a smartphone at chest height; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — sitting on the ground; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — crouching low on her heels; a city rooftop party under string lights — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds her keepsake at chest height
